name: Best Friend House
original_name: ベストフレンドハウス
overview: Three real-life best friends: comedian Yūki Himura (Bananaman), actor Toma Ikuta, and actor Tomoya Nakamura, spend two days together in a Yamanashi cottage, filmed by 15+ fixed cameras for an unscripted, no-narration “friendship” docu-reality.
